### Text encoding note

File encoding used: `latin-1`. Non-ASCII text cells are counted above. For the Kaggle file, accented characters were already corrupted before publication (e.g. 'Café' appears as 'Cafí©'); common decode/re-encode chains (latin-1, cp1252, mac_roman, cp437, cp850, utf-8) did not recover the original text, so values are kept as-is. This affects display names only; grouping is unaffected because the corruption is consistent.
